svg.title: P008 · Price band labels
svg.desc: One row per product with one budget label. The Pen costs 199 and enters Budget. The other four rows still need a label. The Book at 200 and Bag at 699.50 both enter Mid. The Watch at 700 misses this band. The Watch becomes Premium. Mystery has a NULL price and receives Unknown. All five products stay.
svg.text: One row per product with one budget label.
Which band owns exactly 200? What about exactly 700?
A triangle marks an example to follow. Shaded columns show what to read. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
The Pen costs 199 and enters Budget. The other four rows still need a label.
The Book at 200 and Bag at 699.50 both enter Mid. The Watch at 700 misses this band.
How do the remaining rows get labels?
The Watch becomes Premium. Mystery has a NULL price and receives Unknown. All five products stay.
